name: Ray-Ray Intersection
definition: Computes the least-squares intersection point of two rays in 3D space. Used when rays do not intersect exactly (e.g., due to noise or parallax), finding the point that minimizes the squared distance to both rays.
summary: Ray-Ray Intersection computes the least-squares point minimizing distance to two non-intersecting 3D rays, distinguishing itself by operating in full 3D space rather than specific coordinate planes.
